description: Free wrapper. Runs any catalog tool missing from your tools/list exactly as a direct call: args pass through unchanged and the inner tool's price, payment, result and errors apply verbatim. Its hints are the worst case over the whole catalog: not read-only because some inner tools create a render, a stored file or a ledger entry; never destructive because no catalog tool deletes or overwrites anything. Get the inner tool's name, schema and its own annotations from tool_catalog(tool='<name>') first. A missing or unknown name errors pointing to tool_catalog; it cannot call itself.

args.description: Object matching that tool's inputSchema. Omit if none required.

name.description: Exact tool name from tool_catalog. Not 'use_tool'.

name: use_tool
title: Run any catalog tool
